notes: Listing data last updated 2026-09-25 (272 reviews); live Google SERP on 2026-11-12 shows 4.9 stars and 275 reviews, used here. Competitor ratings and review counts also from the live SERP (Canna Cabana listing data showed 3.8/55, SERP shows 4.0/67).

All four domains are chain domains: spiritleaf.ca, popscannabis.ca, plantlifecannabis.com and cannacabana.com traffic, ranking and backlink numbers cover every store in the chain, not the Sherwood Park location. The store also runs its own site, spiritleafsherwoodpark.ca: 31 ranking searches, 3 in top 10, estimated 30 visits/month, no backlinks in the index.

Traffic is DataForSEO estimated monthly organic visits in Canada, Nov 2025 to Oct 2026. The live overview for spiritleaf.ca shows 18,052 for the current month, lower than the Oct 2026 historical figure of 39,660.

The Google profile website URL (spiritleaf.ca/locations/sherwood-park-south/) returned HTTP 404 in a plain fetch; with JavaScript on it lands on spiritleaf.ca/collections/spiritleaf-sherwood-park (200). Not checked in a human browser session; our egress proxy blocked direct fetches, so this came from DataForSEO's crawler.

Search volumes are Google Ads, Alberta level. 'weed store' (12,100) and 'dispensary' (9,900) are province-wide volumes, not Sherwood Park only. Google Ads returned no volume for 'near me' cannabis searches (likely restricted), so they were not used.

Google SERPs were run with location 'Sherwood Park, Alberta, Canada' (the SERP tool has no coordinate option) and returned about 10 organic results despite depth 20. 'dispensary' searches in Sherwood Park also surface Dispensaries Ltd., a pharmacy.

Google AI Overviews appeared on 'dispensary sherwood park', 'dispensary open now' and 'best dispensary sherwood park', but the tool returned them as asynchronous with no content, so all AI Overview slots are scored 0 (not measured, not confirmed absent). answers_naming_you = 22 non-brand LLM answers + 4 brand answers.

Sherwood Park has 2 other Spiritleaf stores named in AI answers (Salisbury at 115 Tisbury St; Baseline Rd). We counted an answer only when it named Spiritleaf in Sherwood Park; most cited 52 Brentwood Blvd. Claude's answers cited a Yelp 'Spiritleaf - Sherwood Park' page that is this store.

Competitor Google top 20 counts: Canna Cabana's 'weed store' organic hit is cannacabana.com/pages/store/sherwood-park, which may be its Fir St store rather than the Sherwood Dr store. Some AI answers named Canna Cabana's Fir St store; counted as Canna Cabana mentions.
Pop's and Plantlife homepages blocked the DataForSEO crawler (HTTP 403), so their load time, on-page score and alt text are null. Load times are Lighthouse desktop largest contentful paint.

Competitors chosen by local pack appearances across the 6 non-brand searches: Canna Cabana (Sherwood Dr) 3, Pop's 2, Plantlife 2, Fire & Flower Baseline 2, Kurve 2, Value Buds Baseline 2. Plantlife chosen over Fire & Flower on review count (159 vs 121). FOUR20 appeared in 1 pack.

Price: no cited average spend per visit for Alberta or Canada was found. Closest figure: Headset reports the Alberta average cannabis item price at $22.31 in October 2026 (headset.io/markets/ab), which is per item, not per visit, so price is left null.
PR count is news outlets only. Canna Cabana Sherwood Park had a High Tide press release on newswire.ca (not counted as news).
